name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. The text-to-speech API generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43KB, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono) from the input text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart's example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers, but the sandbox has no audio output. I modified the script to save the generated audio to a file (`output.mp3`) instead, which is more verifiable in this headless environment. The quickstart also mentions installing MPV/FFmpeg for audio playback, but this was unnecessary since we saved to file rather than playing. The core API call and TTS generation followed the quickstart exactly.
